No Rate Limiting on Password Reset Email Requests

Because password reset emails are necessary to prevent the user from being locked out of their account, users aren't able to unsubscribe from them like other email types. This means our standard per-IP rate limiting was insufficient, since attackers could annoy users by requesting password resets from many different IP addresses. We improved our logic by applying a per-account limit, since each password reset request for a given account gets delivered to the same email address, effectively making it so that only one password reset request could be outstanding for a user at any given time. We also made sure to reset the rate limit counter when the password reset was successfully completed.
